name: Gallio
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things. So here is what I want everyone to see. There is a progression of that bitterness that we started out with, to now, where that same bitterness went from speaking evil in 2 Corinthians chapter 10, talking junk, to where they are actually putting hands on people.
